description: Lexicographically earliest infinite sequence such that a(i) = a(j) => A046523(i) = A046523(j), A003557(i) = A003557(j) and A053669(i) = A053669(j), for all i, j >= 1, where A046523(n) is the smallest number with same prime signature as n, A003557(n) is n divided by its squarefree kernel, and A053669(n) is the smallest prime not dividing n.
